column1: # Self-displaying C64 PRGs and PrintMaster, none of which RECOIL supports

column4: RECOIL rejects PrintMaster .GRA. Layout from the GoDot PrintMaster loader page (88x52, uncompressed hires, $8B row header, MIT) and checked on 59 CSDb samples. Output reviewed: clip-art figures, black on white.

RECOIL rejects viewer-wrapped Koala PRGs. Layout read from the viewer operands (bitmap to $6000, screen to $4400, colours to $D800, multicolour bitmap mode, border/background read from file bytes) and checked on 416 (10500 bytes) / 387 (10608 bytes) CSDb files. Output reviewed: coherent multicolour pictures, backgrounds match the file bytes.

RECOIL rejects self-displaying PETSCII PRGs. Layout read from the SYS 2061 stub operands (copy loops from $0861/$0C49 to $0400/$D800, $D018 selects the ROM set, $D020/$D021 immediates) and checked on 1882 CSDb files. Output reviewed: PETSCII art with the right set, colours and background.
